displayName.description: The name of the brand. DisplayName must be unique per projectId and marketCode (US)

importType.description: Type of import, options are IMPORT_TCR_BRAND for 10DLC / RCS and IMPORT_GCH_BRAND for Short Code

x-enumDescriptions.IMPORT_TCR_BRAND: Import an existing brand in 10DLC. Imported brand will get same channels as in original request (10DLC, 10DLC+RCS). 10DLC brand Id must be included as external brand.
x-enumDescriptions.IMPORT_GCH_BRAND: Import an existing brand in the US Short Code Registry. Imported brand will get Short Code channel. The US Short Code Registry brand Id must be included as external brand.

externalBrandId.description: The external brand ID obtained in the original order. It can be the 10DLC brand Id or the US Short Code Registry brand Id.

callbackUrl.description: The URL to receive the order status update callback. The URL must be a valid URL and must be reachable from Sinch.
